notes.source: Rainfall: NASA GPM IMERG V07 daily, averaged over each upazila polygon. Temperature and ET0: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 reanalysis, CERES solar), from 1998, Tmax bias-corrected against the BMD Feni station. Reanalysis and satellite data, not station records.
notes.grid: GPM rainfall (about 10 km) differs between upazilas. NASA POWER temperature is one 0.5 x 0.625 degree cell for all six upazilas: the temperature charts are the same for every upazila.
notes.short_record: 28 years of GPM rain (1998-2025) is a short record. Mann-Kendall has little power over it, so 'no significant trend' is not evidence of no change. The frequencies below describe the climate you farm in now; they are not forecasts.
notes.imerg_eras: IMERG combines TRMM-era (to May 2014) and GPM-era satellite inputs; a seam in rain-rate histograms at June 2014 is documented by NASA (Huffman 2019, Caveats for IMERG in the TRMM Era). Counts of heavy-rain days and dry spells can shift there.
notes.significance: A trend is reported only when Mann-Kendall p < 0.05 and it is not explained by a single break in the record (Pettitt test). Heat uses percentile thresholds (days above the 1998-2010 90th percentile).
